text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos left yesterday for Italy for a private visit of some days. He is accompanied by his wife and some members of his cabinet.
- The Petroleum Minister Albina Assis is going to participate in the 16th annual session of the African Petroleum Producing Countries, between 16th and 17th June in Brazzaville.
